texts: good. a clean, fireable rule: the Cliff Path hunt is the trigger, "that survives the hunt" is a condition on each nightmoth, and the flight to the Hollows is the per-occurrence result.

good. the rule fires on a Cliff Path hunt and records the Hollows lanterns gaining nightmoths; the gain is stated of the lantern group as a whole rather than of each lantern, which is the best the rule form allows.

mixed: the shape is right — the moths keep the lanterns productive, and "productive" is handed down to each lantern — but "nightmoths" came out here as the symbol night_moth while the neighbouring sentences give nightmoth, so facts about the same creature will not join up. Spell the creature the way you already spell "sky-cat" and "lantern-row", hyphenated and identical everywhere: "The displaced night-moths keep the Hollows lanterns productive." Using "night-moth(s)" in the other lore sentences too would keep all of them on one symbol.
